mapper.select: SELECT id FROM w16_safe_exit_guard WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT ticket_id, actor_id, match_id, choice, phase, handoff, solo_state, solo_block, goal_ref, launch_receipt, resumed, created_at FROM w16_safe_exit WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_safe_exit(ticket_id, actor_id, match_id, choice, phase, handoff, solo_state, solo_block, goal_ref, launch_receipt, resumed, created_at) VALUES(#{ticketId}, #{actorId}, #{matchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{choice}, #{phase}, #{handoff}, #{soloState}, #{soloBlock,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{goalRef,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{launchReceipt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resumed}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE w16_safe_exit SET solo_state=#{soloState}, solo_block=#{soloBlock,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, launch_receipt=#{launchReceipt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, resumed=#{resumed} WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND solo_state='STARTING'
